summary: A Depth subscription on an NFO future: TradeSmart's depth snapshot (dk) gives a Depth frame with the quote, OI and the five-level book; a partial (df) moves the best levels and the OI; a book of zeros clears every level; the unsubscribe releases the depth subscription.

notes: Noren sends OI as oi and toi, and each member reads it as its web adapter does (audit FB-07): TradeSmart streams the native oi, never toi. The partial carries an oi change without toi to show which one is read.
Circuits, the 52-week range and depth_level go out in Depth frames as the web sends them.

deviations.reason: The web's TradeSmart adapter forwards Noren's ltt as text (HH:MM:SS), or null when the frame has none; feed times are epoch milliseconds (docs), and a text copy of a time is not sent (docs/port/market-data-frames.md). The Noren family sends no ltt key (feed/dialect/names.rs).

The web's TradeSmart adapter sends Noren's pc as percent_change only, with no price_change keys; the desktop sends the canonical price_change and price_change_percent beside percent_change. Lead ruling 2026-11-09: the Noren members turn the canonical change keys off and keep percent_change, by lane wire's per-broker key rule (pending).
